---
title: "Research Interests"
---

My research interests focus on digital hardware systems for embedded and cyber-physical applications, with emphasis on FPGA/SoC design, hardware acceleration, and real-time implementation.

## Core Research Areas

- VLSI, FPGA and System-on-Chip (SoC) design
- FPGA-based hardware acceleration
- High-Level Synthesis (HLS) and hardware/software co-design
- Embedded systems and edge devices

## Application Domains

- Control, estimation, and sensor fusion
- UAVs, autonomous vehicles, and mobile robotic systems
- Hardware-in-the-loop systems and digital twins
- Surgical robotics applications
